channel.title: Wire — DevOps
channel.description: DevOps from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Netflix Titus Adds Single-Tenant VM Isolation for Containers
item.description: Netflix has added single-tenant Titus, a mode that runs one task alone on its own right-sized EC2 instance. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Microsoft Retires Azure Deployment Environments with No Replacement Product
item.description: Azure Deployment Environments retires on February 22, 2027 and Microsoft names no successor, telling teams to use Bicep or ARM templates directly. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: From Working Group to SIG Architecture: spotlight on AI Conformance
item.description: In this SIG Architecture spotlight we talked with Janet Kuo (Google) and Yuan Tang (Red Hat) about the journey of AI Conformance in Kubernetes, from the initial Working Group to the integration SIG Architecture as a subproject. (1 source: kubernetesblog)
